tools.description: Main tool of the learning loop: prepare one authorized teaching turn for the learner. mode=context (default) is read-only: learner profile and accessibility, focused curriculum, difficulties, recent observations, active session and narrative memory. mode=activity also opens or resumes the learning session and freezes the canonical engine decision in `decision`: activity, pedagogical_contract (follow llm_instruction, constraints and allowed_variants; keep audit_rationale internal), session_id, tutor_mode, motivation_brief, metacognitive_mirror, active_misconceptions, mastery_evidence, mastery_uncertainty and transfer_profile. Alert-aware routing is already applied. Pass an idempotency_key so a retried activity call replays the same decision. Without a conversation, the domain comes from domain_id, domain_name or the last active domain; needs_domain_setup=true means the learner has no domain yet. Bound native conversations select trainings with training_id or an exact training_name; ambiguous names return needs_selection with bounded choices - never guess or enroll implicitly. presentation distinguishes instruction, assessment and guidance. Freeze an assessment with prepare_assessment_attempt before display, submit the actual answer, then record_interaction. When pedagogical_contract.reasoning_request is present, write a 2-3 sentence interpretation_brief (a hypothesis about the learner's state from the supplied traces, without inventing facts) before generating the activity and pass it to record_interaction.

session_id.description: durable learning session ID; omit to close the learner's active session

tools.name: record_session_close

tools.description: Explicitly switch this conversation's active training. Pass expected_selection = the latest selection_version from get_conversation_context and a fresh idempotency_key. init_domain already selects its new training and returns the confirmed context; do not repeat that selection with the old version. Tell the learner which training is now selected.

conversation_id.description: The conversation identifier provided by the native client. Bound transports supply it automatically.

expected_selection.description: Current selection_version returned by get_conversation_context. Read it again after init_domain because creation already selects the training.

idempotency_key.description: Stable idempotency key (1..128 letters, digits, '.', '_', ':', '-'). Reuse only for an identical retry; choose a fresh key for a new action.

training_id.description: Training ID from list_training_library: personal:<domain_id> or formation:<id>.

tools.name: select_conversation_training

tools.description: Set the learner-controlled priority for an active domain. Use rank 1 for the preferred domain; lower numbers win. Domains with any explicit rank are routed before domains with no rank. When ranks are equal or absent, routing falls back to newest created_at first.

idempotency_key.description: optional retry key (1..128 safe characters); reuse only for an exact retry of the same mutation

rank.description: positive integer priority rank. Rank 1 is highest priority; explicit ranks route before unranked domains.

tools.name: set_domain_priority

tools.description: Decompose the learner's personal_goal against the domain's concepts. For each concept, provide a score in 0..1: 1.0 = central to the goal, 0.0 = orthogonal. Incremental semantics (merge): only provided concepts are updated, others retain their previous score. An unknown concept (absent from the graph) returns an explicit error.

domain_id.description: target domain ID (optional; last active domain if absent)

idempotency_key.description: optional retry key (1..128 safe characters); reuse only for an exact retry of the same mutation

relevance.description: map of concept -> relevance score as a 0..1 float. Unknown concepts produce an explicit error. Incremental semantics: only provided concepts are updated.

tools.name: set_goal_relevance

tools.description: Set a common training's audience (open means all institution members), invite a chosen member_id, or authorize an editor (decision=edit). Only the owner can set free_publication. No administrative role is granted.

audience.description: open (all institution members), invitation or approval. share_training defaults to invitation.

decision.description: With member_id: invite (default), revoke, edit (grant editing) or remove_editor.

expected_revision.description: Current revision from get_training; a stale value is rejected as revision_conflict.

free_publication.description: Owner only: let authorized editors publish without review.

idempotency_key.description: Stable idempotency key (1..128 letters, digits, '.', '_', ':', '-'). Reuse only for an identical retry; choose a fresh key for a new action.

training_id.description: Training ID from list_training_library: personal:<domain_id> or formation:<id>.

tools.name: set_training_access

tools.description: Owner only: explicitly set personal_learning. Does not change other institutions or publish any training.

idempotency_key.description: Stable idempotency key (1..128 letters, digits, '.', '_', ':', '-'). Reuse only for an identical retry; choose a fresh key for a new action.

personal_learning.description: Allow personal learning in this institution.

tools.name: set_training_policy

tools.description: Copy only the design of a private training to a shared contribution. Conversations and progress stay private. Supply name, audience and expected_revision. With no training_id, only an institution owner may explicitly create an institutional programme from document. Does not publish or enroll.

audience.description: open (all institution members), invitation or approval. share_training defaults to invitation.

document.description: Complete proposed programme. Personal trainings: send curriculum (from get_training). Institutional trainings: send modules and concepts. Server-computed fields are ignored and may be omitted.

concepts.description: Institutional trainings: 1-500 concepts, each in an existing module_stable_key.

curriculum.description: Personal trainings: the complete next curriculum. Keep every concept id and key; retire concepts instead of removing them.

concepts.description: Active and retired concepts; at most 500.

id.description: Stable concept ID; never change it.

replaced_by.description: For a retired concept: IDs of the concepts that replace it.

status.description: Changing description, level, outcomes, criteria or status invalidates that concept's prior evidence.

modules.description: Institutional trainings: 1-100 modules with unique stable_key.

training.description: Only description is read, when an owner creates an institutional programme with share_training.

expected_revision.description: Current revision from get_training; a stale value is rejected as revision_conflict.

idempotency_key.description: Stable idempotency key (1..128 letters, digits, '.', '_', ':', '-'). Reuse only for an identical retry; choose a fresh key for a new action.

name.description: Name of the shared copy (max 500 bytes).

training_id.description: Training ID from list_training_library: personal:<domain_id> or formation:<id>.

tools.name: share_training

tools.description: Open or resume the learner's durable learning session. Session identifiers are generated by the server: pass session_id only to resume one this server returned. The operation is idempotent and returns the canonical session_id used by interactions, affect, assessment attempts, transfer evidence, intentions and summaries.

idempotency_key.description: optional retry key (1..128 safe characters); reuse only for an exact retry of the same mutation

session_id.description: optional session_id previously returned by this server, to resume it; omit to open or resume the active session

tools.name: start_learning_session

tools.description: Persist the learner's committed response (or its integrity hash) against a previously frozen assessment attempt. The task and rubric cannot change at this stage.

idempotency_key.description: optional retry key (1..128 safe characters); reuse only for an exact retry of the same mutation

learner_response.description: exact learner response; response_content_hash may be used instead for sensitive or external artefacts

response_content_hash.description: optional lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the exact learner response

tools.name: submit_assessment_attempt

tools.description: Submit this exact draft revision to the institution owner for review. Every later revision requires a new decision unless the owner enables free publication.

expected_revision.description: Current revision from get_training; a stale value is rejected as revision_conflict.

idempotency_key.description: Stable idempotency key (1..128 letters, digits, '.', '_', ':', '-'). Reuse only for an identical retry; choose a fresh key for a new action.

reason.description: Human-readable reason recorded in the audit trail.

training_id.description: Training ID from list_training_library: personal:<domain_id> or formation:<id>.

tools.name: submit_training

tools.description: Generate a novel situation to probe transfer outside the training context. A transferred mastery claim still requires frozen assessment evidence and a trusted evaluation across multiple dimensions.

concept.description: the concept to test in transfer (concept key from the domain graph)

context_type.description: context type: near, far, real_world, interview, teaching, debugging, creative (optional)

tools.name: transfer_challenge

tools.description: Replace the authenticated learner's availability and accessibility policy. Uses expected_revision (the version read from get_availability_model) to reject concurrent lost updates. Notification consent is explicit; DND and local weekly windows are enforced again at delivery time.

extra_processing_time.description: Give extra time before expecting an answer.

screen_reader_optimized.description: Prefer output that works well with screen readers.

do_not_disturb.description: when true, suppress every proactive notification

expected_revision.description: version returned by get_availability_model; use 0 only when no persisted policy exists

idempotency_key.description: optional retry key (1..128 safe characters); reuse only for an exact retry of the same mutation

notification_consent.description: explicit opt-in for proactive webhook notifications

preferred_windows.description: non-overlapping weekly local-time windows; empty means any time after consent

day.description: Weekday of the window (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday).

timezone.description: valid IANA timezone, for example Europe/Paris or America/New_York

tools.name: update_availability_model

tools.description: Resolve one pending practice commitment as honored, missed or cancelled. Ownership and one-way lifecycle transitions are enforced by storage.

idempotency_key.description: optional retry key (1..128 safe characters); reuse only for an exact retry of the same mutation

intention_id.description: implementation intention ID (the id field of list_implementation_intentions)

status.description: terminal status: honored, missed or cancelled

tools.name: update_implementation_intention

tools.description: Write learner memory markdown files for session summaries, concept notes, pending observations, stable memory, or archives.

concept_slug.description: required when scope=concept; must match an active concept

domain_id.description: domain owning a concept note or session; required for new domain-scoped concept memory

idempotency_key.description: optional retry key (1..128 safe characters); reuse only for an exact retry of the same mutation

operation.description: write operation: append, replace_section, or replace_file

period.description: archive period key alias, for example 2026-05 or 2026-Q2

period_key.description: required when scope=archive; for example 2026-05, 2026-Q2, or 2026

period_type.description: archive period type: monthly, quarterly, or annual; saving an archive does not complete maintenance

scope.description: memory scope: memory, memory_pending, session, concept, or archive

session_id.description: durable learning session ID for a session summary; omit only when importing legacy summaries

tools.name: update_learner_memory

tools.description: Update learner-declared preferences (device, objective, language and affect baseline). Evidence-derived calibration and autonomy cannot be overwritten.

idempotency_key.description: optional retry key (1..128 safe characters); reuse only for an exact retry of the same mutation

language.description: preferred language for exercises (BCP-47 hint to the LLM)

tools.name: update_learner_profile

tools.description: Audit the active domain graph deterministically and return structural quality issues plus a prompt the LLM can use to propose graph repairs.

domain_id.description: domain ID (optional; if absent, the learner's active domain is used)

tools.name: validate_domain_graph
